### `-tileflow-apply-schedule`

_Tile, fuse and promote according to tileflow.schedule attributes_

Consumes `tileflow.schedule` attributes on linalg ops. Unless overridden
from the command line, the tile sizes, loop order and promotion set come
from the attribute. When `fuse` is set, producer fusion runs before
bufferization; when `promote` is set, the selected operand tiles are
copied into a function-local scratchpad after bufferization.

#### Options

```
-tile-sizes : Override the schedule tile sizes
-order      : Override the schedule loop order
-fuse       : Fuse producers into the tiled consumer loop nest
-promote    : Promote operand tiles into a scratchpad
-space      : Memory space used for scratchpad promotion
```

### `-tileflow-fuse-producers`

_Fuse producers into tiled consumer loop nests_

### `-tileflow-locality-report`

_Print the analytical data-locality cost report as JSON_

Evaluates every scheduled tileflow op with the analytical locality cost
model and prints one JSON object per op: bytes moved per memory level,
estimated DRAM traffic, arithmetic intensity, reuse-distance statistics
and scratchpad feasibility.

#### Options

```
-machine : Path to a machine description JSON file
```

### `-tileflow-lower`

#### Options

-stop-after : Stop after one of: linalg, schedule, loops, llvm
```

### `-tileflow-lower-to-gpu`

_Lower tileflow through scf.forall and the GPU/NVVM path_

-stop-after : Stop after one of: forall, gpu, nvvm
```

### `-tileflow-promote-to-scratchpad`

_Promote tiled operand slices into a scratchpad buffer_

#### Options

```
-space    : Memory space for the scratchpad (private or workgroup)
-operands : Operand names to promote (A, B, Q, K, V)
```

### `-tileflow-tile-for-locality`

_Tile scheduled linalg ops for data locality_

#### Options

```
-tile-sizes : Tile sizes (overrides the schedule attribute)
-order      : Loop interchange order (overrides the schedule attribute)
```

### `-tileflow-to-linalg`

_Lower tileflow ops to linalg on tensors_

Lowers `tileflow.matmul`, `tileflow.softmax_row` and
`tileflow.attention` to equivalent linalg ops. The schedule attached to
the source op is copied to every produced linalg op as the discardable
attribute `tileflow.schedule`, where the scheduling stages pick it up.

### `-tileflow-to-llvm`

_Lower scheduled loops all the way to the LLVM dialect_

Runs affine -> scf -> cf, vector -> llvm, memref -> llvm, arith/math/
index -> llvm, func -> llvm and reconciles unrealized casts. The result
contains only the LLVM dialect (plus the builtin module).

### `-tileflow-to-loops`

_Bufferize and lower scheduled linalg ops to loops_

Runs one-shot bufferization (if tensor IR is still present), optionally
vectorizes linalg ops, then lowers linalg to `scf.for` loops. The
`unroll` option unrolls innermost loops with a constant trip count.

#### Options

```
-vectorize : Vectorize linalg ops before lowering to loops
-unroll    : Unroll innermost constant-trip-count loops by this factor
```
